query_counts.scope: Existing production query counters; window deltas exclude initialization. native_field_threads is a cumulative peak retained only in raw snapshots. Counts do not establish elapsed cost, graph misses or work omitted by existing counters.

semantics.business_validation: Driver must compare frozen world, RNG and semantic event output against the plain same-input run.
semantics.denominator: Externally measured full ordinary Simulation.step elapsed, including its pending wait loop.
semantics.nested_calls: Inclusive and exclusive selected dynamic calls; exclusive subtracts timed descendants. Never add inclusive rows or add nested rows to root rows.
semantics.observer_handler_us: Measured handler bodies only; wrapper dispatch and timer read overhead are not fully isolatable. Quantify total perturbation against a paired plain same-input window.
semantics.residual_us: Full step minus root spans and observed handlers: outer step setup, pending sleeps, call/return gaps and timer precision.
semantics.root_stages: Disjoint spans in the original step_nonblocking phase order; observed handler time removed.

r1_errors: Comprehensive workload did not satisfy its business coverage contract

dense_intervals.scope: Each contiguous measured interval with at least 90 percent of the complete initial population. Every interval is reported separately; short intervals remain insufficient evidence and no actors are held, replaced or removed.

scope: Selected exclusive subtracts only selected child span elapsed. enter root/parent preparation happens before its started timestamp; leave row/edge maintenance happens after its now timestamp. These handler costs are unmeasured separately and fall into selected parents or the outer-step remainder. Counts and caller trees identify candidates; no diagnostic elapsed difference establishes plain CPU or speedup.

verification.scope: Main-driver-thread selected inclusive/exclusive elapsed. Exclusive removes only selected nested spans; it still contains untimed work, waits and hook overhead and is not CPU time. Outermost probed-method labels and parent edges distinguish movement descendants from other callers. Workers never write this timer. No worker_diagnostics or production rule is changed. Business-coverage errors remain separate; exact diagnostic equality does not establish coverage or performance compliance.

source_and_environment.scope: Measured source authority is the frozen2222-file map derived from original A; enclosing Git commit records published diagnostic tooling, not new business implementations.
